title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.OPS #MCP-OWNER-READS: MCP tools get_blind_spots and get_standards so every agent sees what the owner cannot
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=site/agentic.js
code-anchor: export const LIVE_TOOLS

**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** weekly product-manager pass; the roadmap item is taken by the executor when it is next in driver order
**Program:** QNFO.OPS
**Metric it should move:** owner_load
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call (fleet_budget cap is breached; cost 426.89 vs 300).
**Done check:** grep:site/agentic.js::get_blind_spots ; merged and verified live (VERIFY-LIVE-1) with a probe the author did not write
**Status:** closed

Expose BLINDSPOT-1 register (open sweeps, learned gaps) and the standards register (supported/partial/planned with proof) as read tools, so any agent in any harness proposes the next improvement from the same facts. Prediction: agent sessions that file an originated item per turn rise from ~0; metric owner_load.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 168.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
